dedupe_keys.name: dlr eoc geoservice earth observation center dataset catalogue and download service

description: The Geoservice of the DLR Earth Observation Center is a catalogue and download service for the Earth observation datasets that DLR produces, filtered by theme (atmosphere, hydrosphere, topography, anthroposphere, satellite imagery, cryosphere, climate variables, biosphere, natural hazards, pedosphere) and by group. Datasets listed on the page read include the TanDEM-X 30 m edited digital elevation model, DEM change maps, the 90 m DEM, coastline and forest/non-forest map; the World Settlement Footprint 2015, 2019, Evolution, 3D and 3D material stock; the Global Urban Footprint; burnt area products for Europe from MODIS and Sentinel-3; the Global WaterPack and Surface Water Inventory and Monitoring water extent; the Global SnowPack; forest canopy cover loss, forest structure and tree species maps for Germany; the TIMELINE AVHRR series (1982 to 2022); and EnMAP and DESIS hyperspectral archives. Files are served from open download directories, access is free, and licence terms are set per dataset. Caveats: products differ in resolution, date and licence, so each dataset page must be checked before use. Coverage is global for many products and Germany or Europe for others. It supports hazard exposure analysis with terrain, settlement, water and burnt-area layers; related records are ESA Earth Online and the DLR ionosphere monitoring service.
